subject: POC success criteria & next steps (Redwood POC) - follow up
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Kent <akent@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & next steps (Redwood POC)

Hi Alexandra - great to meet today. Short recap and proposed success criteria so we have alignment before the POC kickoff. Leaving room to tweak based on your expected traffic and quality bar.

High-level scope
- 2-week trial against a production-like query set (you provide traffic script + sample dataset)
- Goal: validate latency, throughput, cost, and quality under expected load

Proposed KPIs (primary):
- Latency: p95 < 200 ms (in-region, end-to-end, network included)
- Throughput: baseline 100 req/s sustained, with ability to handle 200 req/s short spikes
- Cost: effective cost <= $0.0008 per token (ballpark; final depends on model/quantization)
- Quality: intent match / accuracy >= 92% on your labeled eval set; hallucination rate < 2% on critical intents

Evaluation plan
- You share a 500-1,000 sample labeled eval set + traffic profile (time distribution, typical prompt lengths)
- Redwood will stand up a dedicated trial endpoint, preconfigure batching and KV cache, and run a 48h soak test with a replay of a representative window
- We'll produce: latency/throughput dashboard, token cost estimate, and a quality report (confusion matrix + example failures)

Ownership & timelines
- Redwood (Jordan / Alex): infra setup, endpoint config, run soak test, produce reports
- Atlas (Alexandra): share sample eval set and traffic profile by EOD 18 May; provide procurement contact for trial order
- Procurement / Legal (Marissa): SOW/Trial order and payment details

Next steps
1) Alexandra to confirm KPIs and share dataset/traffic by EOD today (18 May)
2) Redwood to provide trial SOW + cost estimate (1 business day)
3) Kickoff call: Thurs 20 May 09:00 PT (proposed)

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf, sample_eval_template.csv

Thanks - Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
From: Alexandra Kent <akent@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps (Redwood POC)

Thanks Jordan - nice summary. A few adjustments from our side:

- Throughput: our steady-state is closer to 50-75 req/s, but we do have daily peak windows that can approach ~200 req/s for 10-15 minutes. So as long as the system can handle those spikes it's fine.
- Latency: our product team is comfortable with p95 <= 250 ms (slightly looser than 200 ms). p50 and p90 are helpful but p95 is the gating metric.
- Cost: cost/token target is important, but we primarily care about cost per 1k requests for this trial - can you include that conversion in the estimate?
- Quality: 90% accuracy on our labeled sample is the minimum acceptable; >92% is a stretch goal.

We will share a 750-record labeled eval set plus a 6-hour sample traffic window (timestamps and payload sizes) by EOD today. Procurement contact is procurement@atlas-payments.com - they'll handle the trial order.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) is required for predictable p95 behavior, or if hosted endpoints with autoscaling will be sufficient for the trial? If dedicated is recommended, please include pricing and any minimum terms.

Looking forward to the kickoff on Thursday - Alexandra

--
Alexandra Kent
Product Lead, Platform Integrations | Atlas Payments
akent@atlas-payments.com | +1 (617) 555-0133
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alexandra Kent <akent@atlas-payments.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps (Redwood POC)

Looping internal owners and summarizing action items from Alexandra's reply. Quick notes:

- Adjusted KPIs per customer: p95 <= 250 ms (gating), steady throughput 50-75 req/s, 200 req/s short spikes; quality >= 90% minimum.
- Customer will provide 750-record eval set + 6h traffic window by EOD 18 May (they've confirmed).

Action items (owners):
- Jordan (me): stand up trial endpoint, run the 48h soak, produce latency/throughput dashboard and quality report. Target: report ready by Tue 25 May.
- Alex Martinez: validate model variant & quantization option (Llama-2-13B quantized vs Llama-2-7B) and produce perf vs quality tradeoff notes. Deliverable: short recommendation doc by Mon 24 May.
- Marissa Cole: prepare SOW/trial order + procurement liaison; share DocuSign link.
- Marissa / Finance: prepare a cost estimate that converts token-level cost to cost per 1k requests (include both hosted and Dedicated pricing).

Attachments: proposed_canary_plan.md, dedicated_pricing_sheet.xlsx

Internal: let's meet 19 May 09:00 PT to confirm infra plan before kickoff. I'll book a 30-min slot.

Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Kent <akent@atlas-payments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & next steps (Redwood POC)

Hi Alexandra / Jordan - thanks for the alignment. A few procurement/logistics items to keep things moving:

1) SOW / Trial Order: attaching the standard trial SOW for Redwood Trial (redwood_sow_trial.pdf). I'll send this via DocuSign to procurement@atlas-payments.com today. Please review the payment and trial term (2 weeks) sections and let me know any edits.

2) SOC2 / Security: Atlas requested SOC2 artifacts. Sharing our security questionnaire link here: https://drive.google.com/redwood-security-soc2-questionnaire - feel free to share with your security team.

3) Timeline: if we receive signed SOW by 21 May EOD we can schedule the trial to begin 24 May (infra prep + config on 24, soak test 25-26).

4) Credits / Commercials: We can offer a small trial credit; I'll confirm the exact amount after procurement confirms the purchase order number.

DocuSign will come shortly. Let me know if you want me to loop in legal for any SOW redlines.

Best,
